Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Reset busy state on failed export to re-enable the Export button
args.body:
src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `busy` state is not reset when the export fails, which leaves the Export button permanently disabled. This should be reset in the failure path, just as it is in the success path, to restore usability after a failed export.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `busy` state is not reset when the export fails, leaving the Export button permanently disabled until a page reload. The fix requires updating the failure path to reset this state.
